audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Wukong / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Wukong / Ornn / Ornn in both layers. The mirror set rows 2, 5 and 6 to Skill and row 4 to Ornn, which is packet.levelChart exactly: Wukong / Skill / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Skill.
audit.why: The whys on this page already say the mirror's version — whys[2] 'keeping the lane even', whys[4] 'stays his', whys[5] 'the lane evens', whys[6] 'it stays even'. Four rows were showing a winner the sentence under them contradicted.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 2, 4, 5 and 6 in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group. Ratings moved with them: 5/10 on the three Skill rows and 3/10 at Level 6, which is the inverse of the mirror's 7/10 for Ornn on the same row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was stored as Wukong's phase with the line 'Cyclone's double knockup wins every committed brawl', which now sits under an Ornn row, and Call of the Forge God is described only as 'a long-range engage-and-knockup'.
audit.why: His R is a 2500-range summon that travels TOWARD him and gets faster as it comes, which he can then recast to charge into and redirect. That is why it is a lane-crossing threat rather than a point-and-click engage — the danger is the second cast, and the elemental's approach line is what you actually have to leave.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[4].why for the Ornn row and put the travel-toward-him, recast-to-redirect behaviour and the 140s rank-1 cooldown into the level 6 spike. Spike count and 'when' values untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The knockup is attributed to the wrong ability in three places: whys[3] 'Q knock-up', wants.foe[1] 'Knock you up with Q into R engage', and spikes[0] 'Q Volcanic Rupture knock-up'. Volcanic Rupture does not knock up. It is an 800-range fissure on 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s that damages and SLOWS, and then a magma pillar forms at the end of it after a short delay. The knockup is SEARING CHARGE (E), a 450-range charge on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s that only knocks up if ORNN COLLIDES WITH TERRAIN mid-charge.
audit.why: This is the whole Ornn combo and the page has it backwards. He drops the Q pillar first specifically so that his E has something to slam into — the pillar he just created is the terrain. Knowing that turns the matchup readable: once the pillar is on the ground you know the knockup is coming and you know which side of it to stand on. A player told 'his Q knocks up' will dodge the fissure, relax, and then get launched by the E.
audit.corrected: Reassigned the knockup to Searing Charge with its 450 range and 14s rank-1 cooldown, described Volcanic Rupture as a slow that leaves a pillar, and stated the Q-pillar-into-E sequence. Also noted the pillar is terrain that sits in the way of your own dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get brittle-procced' but its body is unrelated boilerplate about burning a spell of yours, and breakdown.cooldowns carries no numbers.
audit.why: Bellows Breath is on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Searing Charge on 14s at rank 1 — those two windows are when you are allowed to commit, and neither was written anywhere.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the don'ts, the do's, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

notes: The knockup attribution is the significant fix: Volcanic Rupture slows and leaves a pillar, Searing Charge is the knockup and only when he collides with terrain — so the pillar he just placed is the setup for his own charge. The page had the player dodging the wrong ability. Three claims already on the page could NOT be verified from this brief and were therefore left exactly as written rather than removed or restated: that Bellows Breath grants CC immunity / 'unstoppable', that Brittle adds bonus TRUE damage, and the amount of any of it. Riot's text for Bellows Breath says only that he advances breathing fire and the final gout applies Brittle, and never defines what Brittle does — the mirror hit the same wall and softened its own 'cancels' language for the same reason. A human with the Wiki should confirm those three before the next pass. Note packet.games is 309 while the brief header says 2400.
